entities.name: Katachthon Mountains
entities.description: A harsh volcanic range east of Akros on Theros, steeped in old untamed magic said to predate the gods.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: City whose lands of the Akroans lie in the Katachthons.

entities.name: Oraniad Mountains
entities.description: Divinely touched mountains, larger than the Katachthons.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God of the forge and fire, whose home is Mount Velus.

entities.name: Mount Velus
entities.description: An active volcano serving as Purphoros's home in the mortal world.

entities.name: Thraxes
entities.description: A red dragon who lairs in Purphoros's first residence.

entities.name: Mount Vesios
entities.description: A smaller volcano erupting with Mount Velus, with a monastery of scholars.

entities.name: Mount Sulano
entities.description: A mountain that erupted during the Great Revel.

entities.name: Court of Orestes
entities.description: A crumbling flooded crypt on the Khystonos River where the oracle Orestes is buried.

entities.name: Orestes
entities.description: Legendary oracle, the first follower of Phenax, buried in the Court of Orestes.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: God whose first follower was Orestes.

entities.name: Pool of Lyth
entities.description: A pond that grants visions but is filled with Pharika's poison and guarded by three harpy sisters.

entities.name: Stolsluko
entities.description: A wolf-toothed night hag whose lair holds an entrance to the Underworld.

entities.name: Great Revel
entities.description: The revel during which Mount Sulano erupted.

events.summary: Mount Sulano erupted during the Great Revel.
events.quote: A mountain which erupted during the Great Revel .

events.summary: The Khystonos River was partially blocked by a rockfall, revealing the Court of Orestes.
events.quote: After being partially blocked by a rockfall, its waters run low.

relations.note: The volcano is his home in the mortal world.
relations.quote: serving as Purphoros's home in the mortal world
the dragon Thraxes also lairs here
a harsh, volcanic range east of Akros
